name: Lippmann iNeurons, 20X
notes: The same cells imaged with a 20X water-immersion objective (0.685 µm per pixel), so 24 pixels is again about 16 µm. Outlines at least 8 µm across count as cells. A 20X objective resolves more cells per mm² than 10X: never pool or directly compare 20X results with 10X ones.
